+++ b/lizard_languages/tsx.py
@@ -7,7 +7,7 @@ Only overrides tokenization to handle JSX-specific syntax (<Component>, {express
 
 from .js_style_regex_expression import js_style_regex_expression
 from .typescript import (
-    NULLISH_COALESCING, OPTIONAL_ACCESS, TypeScriptReader)
+    NULLISH_COALESCING, OPTIONAL_ACCESS, OPTIONAL_NAME, TypeScriptReader)
 from .typescript import JSTokenizer, Tokenizer
 from .javascript_templates import template_tokens
 
@@ -27,6 +27,7 @@ class TSXReader(TypeScriptReader):
             r"|(?:<\/[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*(?:\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*)*>)" + \
             r"|(?:#\w+)" + \
             r"|(?:\$\w+)" + \
+            OPTIONAL_NAME + \
             NULLISH_COALESCING + \

             r"|(?:<\/\w+>)" + \
diff --git a/lizard_languages/typescript.py b/lizard_languages/typescript.py
index a63b5e4..8d425ef 100644
--- a/lizard_languages/typescript.py
+++ b/lizard_languages/typescript.py
@@ -13,6 +13,9 @@ from .javascript_templates import template_tokens
 # One token, so each ? in ?? is not its own ternary decision.
 NULLISH_COALESCING = r"|(?:\?\?)"
 OPTIONAL_ACCESS = r"|(?:\?\.(?!\d))"
+# An optional member or parameter, "name?: T" or "f(a?)"; in "x?y:0" the
+# "?" opens a ternary.
+OPTIONAL_NAME = r"|(?:\w+\?(?=\s*(?:[:,)]|\Z)))"
 
 
 class Tokenizer(object):
@@ -74,6 +77,5 @@ class TypeScriptReader(CodeReader, CCppCommentsMixin):
     def generate_tokens(source_code, addition='', token_class=None):
         # Private method (#), dollar ($), optional name (?), nullish (??).
         addition = (addition + r"|(?:#\w+)" + r"|(?:\$\w+)"
-                    + r"|(?:\w+\?(?![?.]))" + NULLISH_COALESCING
-                    + OPTIONAL_ACCESS)
+                    + OPTIONAL_NAME + NULLISH_COALESCING + OPTIONAL_ACCESS)
         yield from template_tokens(source_code, addition, token_class)
diff --git a/test/test_languages/testOptionalOperators.py b/test/test_languages/testOptionalOperators.py
index b28e938..1e883c3 100644
--- a/test/test_languages/testOptionalOperators.py
+++ b/test/test_languages/testOptionalOperators.py
@@ -117,3 +117,22 @@ def test_tsx_optional_operators_in_jsx():
                      '  return n > 1 ? <A/> : <B x={p.f()?.g}/>;\n'
                      '};\n', 'tsx')
     assert [f.cyclomatic_complexity for f in result.function_list] == [3]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('suffix', ['js', 'ts', 'jsx', 'tsx'])
+def test_ternary_without_spaces_is_a_decision(suffix):
+    result = analyze('function f(x, y) { return x?y:0; }\n'
+                     'function g(x) { return x?1:x?.y?2:3; }', suffix)
+    assert [f.cyclomatic_complexity for f in result.function_list] == [2, 3]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('suffix', ['ts', 'tsx'])
+def test_optional_member_and_parameter_are_not_ternaries(suffix):
+    result = analyze('class A {\n'
+                     '  name?: string;\n'
+                     '  m(a?: number, b?: string): number { return 1; }\n'
+                     '}\n'
+                     'function f(cb: (a?: number, b?) => void) { return 1; }\n',
+                     suffix)
+    assert [(f.name, f.cyclomatic_complexity, f.parameter_count)
+            for f in result.function_list] == [('m', 1, 2), ('f', 1, 1)]
